## What is your question?

A short paragraph. If your question grew out of trying something
specific, paste the Swift snippet you ran and the output you saw.

## What have you tried?

Links to docs, prior issues, or SwiftUI docs you have already read.
This helps us point you to the right answer faster:

- [`README.md`](../../README.md)
- [`AGENTS.md`](../../AGENTS.md) — locked decisions
- [`ROADMAP.md`](../../ROADMAP.md) — milestone plan
- [`.docc/`](../../.docc/) — DocC catalog (Getting Started, View
  fundamentals, Modifiers, Web Interop)
- [`.harness/docs/`](../../.harness/docs/) — topic files (naming,
  TDD, DocC, JS-bridge, release, repo-layout)

## Is this really a question?

A short checklist. If you answer **yes** to any of these, please close
this and open the matching template instead — it gets the right eyes
on the report faster.

- [ ] This is a bug → use the **bug report** template.
- [ ] This is a feature request → use the **feature request**
      template.
- [ ] This is a security vulnerability → do **not** open a public
      issue; follow [`SECURITY.md`](../../SECURITY.md) and open a
      private GitHub security advisory.
